title: What a pre-solved reset looks like
caption: Near-goal episode 19, scored a success, ran 10 steps. The cube is ALREADY stacked at the first frame -- red-on-green sitting square on the blue base -- and nothing changes for the whole episode. 9 of the 125 stored near-goal reset states (7.2%) spawn inside the 5 mm tolerance like this, which is why the raw success rate cannot be read without splitting by episode length.
